item.title: Assignment Help
item.description: Hey! I am taking an online class that requires us to use R studio. I have just recently gotten a full time job and I am struggling and overwhelmed with what R studio takes to learn and I am well behind in the class. Is anyone available to help me out with what steps I should take to get started? I've tried looking at youtube tutorials but I seem to get lost pretty quickly. Thanks!
